component.name: PlasmaHabit
component.summary: Privacy-first local habit tracker with GitHub-style heatmaps

description.p: PlasmaHabit is a fast, privacy-first, single-user habit tracker running locally on KDE Plasma. It persists all data exclusively in an on-disk SQLite database and visualizes daily completions on GitHub-style contribution heatmaps. Track honest streaks that strictly reset when a required day or week is missed.
